New Large+ Commission Comic featuring Princess Peach, who's stumbled across a very peculiar mushroom in the castle gardens, and it's turned her into something a whole lot rounder, pinker and fertile!

Contains futanari, bimbofication, transformation, hyper expansion, corruption and more :3

Hope you enjoy it!
